solutions.title: Check every substring
solutions.strategy: Try candidate substrings from longest to shortest and return the first palindrome.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are O(n^2) substrings and each palindrome check can scan O(n) characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only loop indices are stored besides the returned substring.

solutions.title: Expand from each center
solutions.strategy: Treat every character and every gap as a center, expand while mirrored characters match, and keep the best range.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each center can expand across a linear span in the worst case.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the current and best boundaries are tracked.

solutions.title: Manacher radius reuse
solutions.strategy: Transform the string with separators and reuse mirrored palindrome radii inside the current right boundary.

timeComplexity.explanation: The moving right boundary advances at most linearly over the transformed string.

spaceComplexity.explanation: One radius value is stored per transformed-string position.
